definitions.explanation: A job title, official position, or credential attached to a person's name. Used on business cards, in introductions, and when describing someone's professional status. Can also refer more broadly to any label or qualification that defines someone's social standing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{肩書|かたが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Put a title on a business card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な{肩書|かたが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
{肩書|かたが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}ら→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ず⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to compete on ability, not rely on titles.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in discussions about Japanese business culture, where titles carry significant weight. The expression {肩書|かたが}き⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ refers to someone who has a title in name only, without real authority or ability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肩書|かたが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (have a title)
- {肩書|かたが}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧ (rely on one's title)
- {肩書|かたが}き⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (title-only, nominal)
- {肩書|かたが}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (have no title/credentials)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{役職|やくしょく}→役職：05514_yakushoku⟧: position, post (specifically within an organization hierarchy)
- {称号|しょうごう}: honorary title or degree (more formal/academic)
